facts.fact: Ila infers that Kunal clipped the corners of the nineteen silvers so the medicine in Ranu could not be traced to his hand; Kunal confirms he never expected anyone to work out why.
Only Ila's mother ever warmed her feet; Ila hides them in the field, keeping them under her or in a bag.

The herders' hut's door is hidden from the Kuhl shoulder by a scree spur. Ila has Kunal keep only a single banked coal under an upturned clay pot, so no flame shows through the smoke hole; the hut stays cold.
Kunal's fingertips are still raw and split and dressed; Ila kisses his knuckles above the dressings.
Kunal carries Ila's pencil leads against his chest, which she cites as something she watched him do (F480).
